titre: Crédit aux entreprises de la zone euro
sous_titre: Taux de croissance annuel des prêts aux sociétés non financières, en %, janvier à juillet 2026

Janvier 2026.texte: The annual growth rate of adjusted loans to non-financial corporations decreased to 2.8% in January from 3.0% in December.

Mars 2026.texte: Annual growth rate of adjusted loans to non-financial corporations increased to 3.2% in March from 3.0% in February

Mai 2026.texte: Annual growth rate of adjusted loans to non-financial corporations increased to 4.0% in May from 3.4% in April

Juillet 2026.texte: Annual growth rate of adjusted loans to non-financial corporations increased to 4.4% in July from 4.0% in June
